title: News from the north: Edward, king of England, is crowned in Paris, and his crowns are joined as a new Angevin Empire

data.account: The King of England is officially crowned in Paris on June 11th, 1429, forming a new 'Angevin Empire' under his rule (Trent)
data.note: the game's tag and the fate of the separate English and French crowns will be read from the next save
